articleTitle: Shopify Homepage Teardown: Jul 2021 to Jun 2026
h1: How Shopify rewrote its homepage over 5 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jul 2021 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "The platform commerce is built on" — direct product statement.
Visible section headings include: "Bring your business online", "Take the best path forward", "With you wherever you’re going".
Navigation includes: "Skip to Content", "Start your business", "Business name generator", "Web address" — product category framing.
Section headings later removed include: "Bring your business online" and "Take the best path forward".

analysis-blocks.label: Jun 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "Be the nextAI all-star" — updated value proposition.
New section headings include: "store they line up for", "Your brand has entered the chat", "Meet your secret weapon, Sidekick".
CTAs no longer present include: "Start your business", "Start free trial", "Explore more examples".

messaging.before: The platform commerce is built on
messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.

messaging.before: Try Shopify free and start a business or grow an existing one. Get more than ecommerce software with tools to manage every part of your business.
messaging.after: Try Shopify free. Build or grow your business fast with AI. Get more than ecommerce software with tools to manage every part of your business.
messaging.note: The new description is shorter and more neutral in tone. Whether this is intentional de-emphasis or a simplification pass is not determinable from text alone.

messaging.before: Start a Business, Grow Your Business - Shopify 14-Day Free Trial
messaging.after: Shopify: The All-in-One Commerce Platform for Businesses - Shopify
